verdict: Baseline 0.7237 — bimodal: p50=1.0, but ~28% wrong values. Discipline (no-Q, no-soft-punt) baselines at 1.0 with strict system prompt; outcome.value_correct (0.719) is the main headroom.

asi.what_worked: enable_thinking=false → 6.7s mean rollout (vs ~80s with thinking). Strict system prompt nails discipline sub-scores at 1.0 from base.
asi.what_failed: Value-correctness fails on ~28% (math/reasoning failures, not discipline). Honesty 0.77 — failure tasks not always declared honestly.
asi.next_focus: H1 default GRPO recipe to lift outcome.value_correct from 0.72 toward 1.0; honesty also has headroom (0.77).

verdict: POSITIVE +0.0171. lr=1e-5 + ECHO λ=0.05 lifts outcome.value_correct 0.7193→0.7368 and honesty 0.7719→0.7842. Re-eval after rollout.py bug fix (kiln unloads adapter when chat req lacks adapter field).

asi.what_worked: ECHO λ=0.05 with conservative LR=1e-5 — even for single-turn cap, ECHO regularizes the policy gradient via system+user CE (mask is empty for env tokens but ECHO term still affects optimizer state).
asi.next_focus: More iters with lr=1e-5 + ECHO + variations (rank, num_gens, chain). Drop high-LR variants from plan.
